payload.writeUp: Claude Code research, 23 Oct 2026: UK angel networks and syndicates. Most classic networks (OION, Archangels, Kelvin, Equity Gap, TRICAPITAL, HBAN, Envestors) keep live deals behind member logins and publish only completed rounds, so most companies here are live Angel Investment Network pitches (unregulated listings: register, then contact the founder), each checked against the company's own site. SEIS/EIS is the company's claim; no advance-assurance letters were seen. Companies already in the pool from other sources were left out.

candidate.name: Dispatch Layer
candidate.subSector: AI helpdesk triage for field service
candidate.teaser: AI helpdesk that turns shared-mailbox emails into routed tickets and Simpro jobs for IT and field-service teams.
candidate.description: Dispatch Layer (DispatchLayer Limited, company no. 17187433) reads a team's shared mailbox, triages each email into a prioritised ticket and can raise Simpro field-service jobs from it; plans run from £399 to £1,800+ a month on single-tenant instances. It is raising £225,000 on Angel Investment Network and states HMRC SEIS advance assurance is confirmed for this round. The pitch claims a paying customer live since July 2026, 4,955 support emails handled with a 37-second median to ticket, a Simpro Marketplace listing and Cyber Essentials certification. Very early: one paying customer claimed; team size unknown.
candidate.discoverySignal: Live AIN pitch; SEIS advance assurance stated for this round.
candidate.researchRuleMatched: SEIS pre-seed with HMRC advance assurance stated

access.notes: Live Angel Investment Network (AIN) pitch. Register free as an investor on AIN, view the full pitch and contact the founder; the investment itself is made directly with the company. AIN shows: 'not approved by an authorised person' (unregulated promotion).

eis.note: Pitch states 'HMRC SEIS Advance Assurance confirmed for this round'.

facts.label: Emails handled
facts.value: 4,955 support emails, median 37 seconds to ticket (Oct 2026)

openQuestions: How many paying customers and what MRR?

assessment.summary: Small, sensible vertical AI tool with SEIS assurance and a marketplace channel; very early traction.
risks: Easy for helpdesk incumbents to copy
AIN listings are unregulated promotions; no platform due diligence or nominee structure.
assessment.bullCase: Simpro ecosystem gives a cheap path to hundreds of field-service firms.
assessment.bearCase: Remains a lifestyle-scale tool; incumbents add AI triage.
assessment.whyNow: SEIS round open now with nothing committed yet.
assumptions: Pitch figures are the company's (or its adviser's) own unaudited claims.

candidate.name: Gurus Direct
candidate.subSector: Enterprise IT and AI expertise marketplace
candidate.teaser: Agentic marketplace to find, verify, book and deliver enterprise IT and AI transformation experts.
candidate.description: Gurus Direct runs a marketplace where enterprises find and book verified IT and AI transformation experts, with AI agents acting for both buyer and expert; live on web, iOS and Android. It is raising £250,000 on Angel Investment Network and states SEIS and EIS advance assurance are in place. The pitch names two former PwC partners and a Blue Prism alliances lead on the team, and projects profitability in year three on £1.25m total capital. No revenue or user numbers are given publicly; two-sided marketplaces are slow to reach liquidity.

candidate.name: MeldSignal
candidate.teaser: Turns public consumer conversation into a cited brand strategy in under an hour, from £299 a month.
candidate.description: MeldSignal is London-based software that produces brand strategy reports from public consumer conversation, citing each point to a dated post; founder and CEO Nil Nuhoglu is named on the site. It is raising £300,000 under SEIS/EIS on Angel Investment Network. The pitch claims 40+ full reports delivered, pricing from £299 a month against five-figure agency projects, an £11 cost per report and 84% gross margin in year one, and two women founders with 23 years' brand strategy experience between them. Early revenue; exposure to general-purpose AI tools doing similar work.

candidate.name: GET Percent
candidate.teaser: Portable power-bank rental stations that earn venues revenue from low phone batteries.
candidate.description: GET Percent provides phone power-bank rental for cafes, bars and venues. The Angel Investment Network pitch (Wales) is raising £500,000 under SEIS/EIS with £150,000 shown as raised, and claims 100 venues secured (150 waitlisted) across the UK, Miami and Vancouver, around £70 per venue weekly after venue share, and franchises sold in Vancouver. Hardware-rental models are capital-intensive and competitive (e.g. ChargedUp).

candidate.name: ZPE
candidate.teaser: Patented AXIALenergy steam engine converting industrial waste heat into electricity, built with Caterpillar.
candidate.description: ZPE Limited (Portskewett, Caldicot, Monmouthshire) designs the patented AXIALenergy engine that converts industrial waste heat to electricity; its site claims up to 15% of waste heat converted with 1–3 year payback. It is raising £3m under EIS on Angel Investment Network with £1.5m shown as raised. The pitch claims Caterpillar as manufacturing partner now in production, a £4.1m order book, a British Steel project that could scale to 150 engines and an Aon-backed performance guarantee. Later and larger than the family's sweet spot; included as an exception for its order book.

candidate.name: Julie
candidate.subSector: AI parenting and child health app
candidate.teaser: Midwife- and doctor-guided AI app for parents of 0–3 year olds covering sleep, feeding and health questions.
candidate.description: Julie (Julie AI Ltd) is a UK AI app for parents of children aged 0–3, guided by midwives, doctors and sleep consultants, with paid plans from £9.99 a month. It is raising £800,000 under EIS on Angel Investment Network with £50,000 shown as raised. The pitch claims 600+ parents, 26% day-30 retention and a 4.9 App Store rating, and a founding team of medical doctors and PhD-trained engineers. Clinical-risk and regulatory questions around AI health advice for children.

candidate.name: Mocean Energy
candidate.subSector: Wave energy and offshore AI data centres
candidate.teaser: Edinburgh wave-energy developer raising Pre-Series A for Blue Core, a self-powered offshore AI data centre.
candidate.description: Mocean Energy, an Equity Gap portfolio company with offices in Edinburgh, Aberdeen, Orkney and Houston, has a decade of offshore wave-power engineering (Blue Star). In July 2026 Equity Gap reported it unveiled Blue Core, an offshore data-centre concept powered by wave, solar and storage, and is raising Pre-Series A funding. Its site invites investors to request a deck and plans a small-scale demo in 2027. Round size, valuation and tax-relief status are not disclosed; capital intensity and technology risk are high.
candidate.discoverySignal: Equity Gap news (29 Jul 2026): raising Pre-Series A for Blue Core.
candidate.researchRuleMatched: Angel-syndicate-backed company with an open round (exception: later stage, EIS unknown)

access.notes: Request the investment deck via the form on Mocean's AI data centres page; Equity Gap members (FCA professional/eligible investors) may also see it via the syndicate.

facts.value: Small-scale onboard compute demo planned for 2027

assessment.bearCase: Concept needs tens of millions before revenue; early investors heavily diluted.
